items.title: Improvements to Highway 6 Related to Future Development Plans
notes: Report from C. Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services C. Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services provided an overview of the report, indicating with significant anticipated growth and employment development planned in the Fergus urban area on both sides of the Highway 6 corridor, the Township would like to establish a collaborative process with land developers, the County of Wellington and the Province (MTO) to complete a preliminary design and staging plan for Highway 6 outside of the connecting link limit of Fergus.

C. Baker responded to questions regarding future public meetings in addition to comments submitted through the Ministry’s website, challenges with the required MTO setbacks and noise mitigation requirements on road design, future consideration for transit, and continued discussions and expected timelines regarding a future Fergus by-pass.

motions.item_title: Report from the Committee of the Whole – December 7 & 8, 2023
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approve the report from the Committee of the Whole dated December 7 & 8, 2023 as follows: 1. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct the OLG funds allocated to Economic Development in 2024 to the Termite Management Program. 2. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to include tennis in the Parks and Recreation Master Plan in 2024. 3. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington delay the following projects from the 2024 Capital Budget until 2025: Tourism Office Renovation ($26,000) Elora Tourism Washroom Design ($50,000) AND THAT the following projects: Sportsplex Pad B Seating Area Heating ($35,000) Sportsplex Hall Basketball Nets ($20,000) be moved from 2025 in the 10 Year Capital forecast into the 2024 capital budget. 4. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington increase the revenue of the Committee of Adjustment by $5,000 in the 2024 budget. 5. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington increase the investment income in the 2024 budget by $50K. 6. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington reduce the transfer to capital asset management in the 2024 budget by $50K. 7. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington remove the rental of the temporary washrooms in downtown Elora in the amount of $14K; from the And direct staff to investigate other funding opportunities for 2024. 8. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to phase in the salary increase for the Members of Council over years 2024 and 2025. 9. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to investigate the profitability of the Fergus Grand Theare and report back to Council. 10. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington adopt Report No. COR2023-111 regarding additional financial disclosure requirements for the 2024 budget year pursuant to Ontario Regulation 284/09. 11. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approve the 2024 Business Plan, as amended as follows: a) Remove Item # 2 (Page 9), Retrofit tourism office space to improve visitor experience and staff workspaces; b) Add Item #17 (Page 17), Install Seating Area Heating at the Sportsplex (Pad B; c) Add Item # 18 (Page 17), Install Basketball Nets at the Sportsplex Hall; d) Add Item # 7 (Page 11) Investigate the profitability of the Fergus Grand Theatre; 12. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington pass a by-law to establish the 2024 fees and charges for various services provided by the Township, and repeal by-laws 2023-01, 2023-06, and 2023-29. 13. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approve an interest free loan to the Elora BIA in the amount of $50K. 14. THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approve the 2024 Budget as amended.

motions.item_title: Enbridge Gas Franchise Renewal Agreement
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approves the form of draft by-law and franchise agreement attached hereto and authorizes the submission thereof to the Ontario Energy Board for approval pursuant to the provisions of Section 9 of the Municipal Franchises Act. AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington requests that the Ontario Energy Board make an Order declaring and directing that the assent of the municipal electors to the attached draft by-law and franchise agreement pertaining to the Corporation of the Township of Centre Wellington is not necessary pursuant to the provisions of Section 9(4) of the Municipal Franchises Act.

motions.item_title: Improvements to Highway 6 Related to Future Development Plans
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington direct staff to engage the Ontario Ministry of Transportation in discussion on a collaborative process on the future design of Highway 6 to service population and employment growth in the Fergus urban area; AND THAT Council supports the inclusion of Active Transportation facilities including sidewalks and multi-use paths within the section of the Highway 6 corridor located in the Fergus urban area; AND THAT Council encourages the Ministry of Transportation to consider a roundabout design for the Highway 6 and Second Line and Wellington Road 22 / Eighth Line intersection improvements as part of the MTO's Class Environmental Assessment and review of alternatives.

motions.item_title: Short-Term Accommodation (STA) and Bed & Breakfast Establishments
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to undertake a multi-step process with reports to Council at various stages: Step 1) Complete an extensive public consultation process and generate an inventory of active short-term accommodations; and Step 2) use the information/data collected to draft a licensing by-law and formulate a strategy, including financial implications, to regulate and enforce short-term accommodations.
